rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad the meetup talk landed — and thank you for offering real hours, not just good wishes. Here's where things stand: I'm shaping Halcyon Threshold's first concrete project — an independent scorecard tracking the safety practices of AI developers who get a lot less public scrutiny than the two or three best-known frontier labs (eval transparency, red-teaming disclosure, incident reporting, that kind of thing). It's exactly the sort of structured-data problem a data analyst would be good at: building the cohort list, pulling together public filings/docs, helping design the scoring rubric so it's defensible. I've got a few things to sort out on my end first (there's a work-contract disclosure I need to clear before anything with my name on it goes public, and I want to lock the grant funding situation). Realistically I'll have something concrete to hand you within the next couple of weeks. Two questions in the meantime so I can plan around your time: (1) does ~5 hrs/week stay roughly accurate for the next month or two, and (2) any particular tools/languages you're strongest in (SQL, Python, Sheets, something else)? Thanks again — this kind of offer is rarer than you'd think. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman directly (low-stakes, not public) pointing her at that scorecard idea and asking about her availability/tools.
